title: hieracium racemosum subsp. leiobium
intro: Hieracium racemosum subsp. leiobium, commonly known as hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
